provenance.descriptorKind: derived v0.18.8 declaration compatibility descriptors, not original execution manifests
limitations: Original screen.json, stage run.json, archived INI files, runtime receipts and native-preflight proofs were not supplied. Derived descriptors check recorded declaration compatibility; they are not recovered original manifests.

Recorded profile/registry hashes, starting armies, openings, strengths, search settings and applied value policies match the reconstructed declarations. Engine names and profile hashes do not attest the executable or its native tables.
Moves and terminal outcomes were not independently replayed. No new matches, engine searches, outcome-fitted material values or individual-piece Elo were produced.
All studies use sixteen related fixed opening cases. Opening-block ranges are conditional; raw game counts do not imply that many independent starting positions.

report.name: Version 18 level1-queens reference screen: batch 1, 40000 nodes
report.question: Compare QcC and QfN as one-point queen purchases against the three frozen L1 references, with a fresh matched QmN control and a separate QfhN four-forward-jump sanity check. Keep exact QfN two-tall-forward movement distinct.

overall.method: Equal opponent means over shared fully completed opening cases; every configured repetition requires a complete color pair. Draws count half a point.

matrix.perspective: row army score against column army; draws count half

notes: Scores use complete color-swapped pairs only, with equal weight for each represented opening prefix. Draws count half a point.
Unpaired completions, move-limit truncations, errors and cancelled games do not become draws or losses.
16 fixed short prefixes are a coarse descriptive screen, not independent samples supporting a precise strength estimate. No material values or individual piece Elo are fitted.
This report validates journal identities and summarizes recorded outcomes; it does not independently replay every move.

evaluationAudit.policy: Fresh Baby Amazon QmN control and QcC / QfN / QfhN level-one queen trials share the established 2771/2833 MG/EG family search prior. Each is a single one-point purchase against one fixed L1 reference purchase. QfN adds only the two tall forward knight jumps; the separate QfhN sanity check adds all four forward knight jumps. The three references retain their frozen priors. Every pair is applied to all six engine tables for both colors. These are controlled search settings, not estimated material values; no earlier scored journals are pooled.

report.name: Version 18 level2-completion reference screen: batch 1, 40000 nodes
report.question: Compare QsN / QvN with a fresh Box queen control and ND / NDmK with a fresh two-point N0 control against the three frozen L2 references. NDmK adds quiet adjacent steps; defer NDmW and NDmF. Retain unchanged Free Boar on the same new cases to review its Rank-pawn counter; this screen does not establish matchups against other experimental upgrades.

evaluationAudit.policy: Fresh Box queen control and QsN / QvN trials share the established 3738/4155 MG/EG queen search prior. ND, NDmK and the fresh level-two N0 control share 1203/1352. NDmK adds adjacent quiet king steps without adjacent captures; NDmW and NDmF are deferred. The unchanged Free Boar comparison retains 1782/1756; all three frozen L2 references retain their own priors. Each body is a single two-point purchase. QsN adds four wide knight jumps; QvN adds four tall knight jumps. Every pair is applied to all six engine tables for both colors. These are controlled search settings, not estimated material values. Earlier queen, Free Boar and historical level-three N0 scores are not pooled; N0 remains in its distinct two-point context.
